description: Upload a file to the remote server via SFTP (secure file transfer, not shell-based). Replaces an existing file at that path unconditionally — there is no overwrite flag and no way to require a new destination.

remotePath.description: Remote file path. No leading or trailing whitespace, and no control, bidirectional or zero-width characters: the approval prompt and the audit record quote this path back.

name: sftp-upload
